tables.name: stories
tables.label: Stories
tables.description: Stories: a novel, cartoon or film, each with a title, a form and a one-line pitch.

tables.name: scenes
tables.label: Scenes
tables.description: Scenes of a story (story column), ordered by scene number, each with a synopsis and a script.

tables.name: panels
tables.label: Panels
tables.description: Storyboard panels of a scene (scene column), ordered by panel number: caption, dialogue and a rough drawing. The sprite and figures columns are reserved for a future figure-to-sprite engine and are unused in the Alpha.

tables.name: story_notes
tables.label: Story notes
tables.description: Notes about a story (story column): characters, places, beats and ideas.
